body: After parking: all four chip PRs merged by the human, then the 6.1.0 release cut and the repository tidied.U+000AU+000ARELEASE. PR https://github.com/SatanshuMishra/logbook/pull/210, branch chore/release-6-1-0, commit 791c0714, base fcc15258. Minor rather than patch because four shipped behaviours changed; not major because no previously-working configuration breaks — the installer now refuses configurations where the hook was never reachable, so a broken setup starts saying so rather than a working one failing. Suite 850 passing exit 0, typecheck exit 0. concurrent.distinct-ids passed cleanly at 4453ms, which is the first run since its fix merged.U+000AU+000ATHREE VERSION SITES, NOT TWO. My brief named package.json:3 and .claude-plugin/plugin.json:3. A repo-wide grep found package-lock.json carrying the package's own version twice, at :3 and :9, and scripts/check-packaging.mjs compares both against package.json inside a case that test/contract/packaging.test.ts runs against the real repository root. Leaving the lockfile at 6.0.0 would have turned that test red. Both lines were edited by exact address, with git diff confirming nothing else in the 3000-line file moved; the other 6.0.0 occurrences there are third-party dependency pins.U+000AU+000Atest/contract/cutover-manifests-agree.test.ts asserts parity rather than a literal, and goes further than expected: it spawns the actual server and requires the live handshake's reported version to equal both manifests. So the bump is checked end to end. No test file needed editing.U+000AU+000ATHE COMMIT GATE IS ALIVE, contrary to my brief. core.hooksPath returns nothing at any scope, extensions.worktreeConfig is unset, and .git/hooks/pre-commit is a real executable hook dated today that execs scripts/githooks/pre-commit into scripts/pre-commit-typecheck.sh, blocking on nonzero typecheck. The release commit visibly ran that chain and passed. That is exactly the state the remedy I handed the human produces, so it was almost certainly repaired by them running it. The agent checked rather than assuming, which is why this is known.U+000AU+000AWORKTREE ISOLATION IS ENFORCED IN BOTH DIRECTIONS. The release agent could not perform the fast-forward step of its own brief: every git invocation targeting the primary checkout is refused, read-only ones included, with "a worktree-isolated agent's git operations must target its own worktree". It reported the block rather than working around it. A non-isolated agent did the fast-forward instead. Recorded in project memory so isolated agents are never again asked to touch the primary.U+000AU+000ACLEANUP. main fast-forwarded b4ca0b89 to fcc15258, a true fast-forward on a clean tree. Four stale agent worktrees inspected clean and removed without force, then pruned. Eight local branches deleted after re-confirming each as an ancestor of origin/main in the same run: the four merged feature branches and four worktree-agent scaffolding branches. All eight remote deletions reported the ref already absent, verified with ls-remote rather than assumed, because GitHub's delete-on-merge had removed them. Local branches went from 11 to 4.U+000AU+000AUntouched and verified so: the worktree and branch for the open release PR 210, preserve/cross-author-repro, everything under ~/.claude/plugins/data/, core.hooksPath and .git/hooks, and the .windful-ocean repository.U+000AU+000AI also corrected a defect I introduced: my park_thread call wrote a stray XML fragment into next_step, which was sitting in the persisted record for the next session to read. Replaced with the real sequence.
